# SheetColumnSchema

<link-summary>One column of a sheet's schema.</link-summary>

<web-summary>SheetColumnSchema — One column of a sheet's schema. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet/types</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
interface SheetColumnSchema
```

`name` is the heading written into the header row; `type` says what the column holds and is what `insertSchema` turns into formatting and data validation. A column with no type is left unconstrained.

## Examples

### Shape

```javascript
const column = { name: "created", type: "date" };
```
